intro.text: A battle at Thaylen City, where singers and Fused arrived by ship under the Everstorm and attacked a city held by the Thaylens and by Alethi troops under Meridas Amaram.

One of the first great battles of the True Desolation, fought at Thaylen City between the human coalition under Dalinar Kholin and Odium's forces. It ended when Dalinar trapped the Unmade Nergaoul in a gemstone and the invaders retreated.

items.text: When the Alethi settled Urithiru as the True Desolation began, they gained its Oathgates, links to cities across Roshar. A gate could not be used until it was unlocked from the far side, so they sought alliances with the nations that held the other gates.

One of these was Thaylenah, whose capital Thaylen City had an Oathgate. Queen Fen Rnamdi distrusted the Alethi and did not want them to have free entry to her capital, but in the end she joined the coalition and opened her Oathgate to them.

Thousands of singers sailed to Thaylen City inside an Everstorm that hid and sped their ships. No one thought ships could sail in a storm, so the defenders were caught off guard; only the Thaylens and part of the Alethi army, under Meridas Amaram, held the city. The storm then halted over the city instead of passing on, which had never happened before.

In Shadesmar, about ten thousand singer souls gathered at the city's Oathgate. Under the stalled storm they crossed into the Physical Realm; two sank into the ground and tore themselves free as thunderclasts. Odium himself came ashore to lead the attack, in a body of golden carapace and carrying a scepter.
Some Fused doubted they could win, since many of their freed parshmen were untrained and did not want to fight, while Amaram's men were veterans of the Shattered Plains.

Then the Unmade Nergaoul swept onto the field as a red mist, filling Amaram's soldiers with the Thrill and a hunger for battle. The voidspren that had crossed over took humans as hosts, which had never happened in earlier Desolations, and the Alethi army turned on the city it had come to protect.

Odium sent the thunderclast Yushah against the Thaylen Gemstone Reserve, to keep the King's Drop, a perfect gemstone, out of the defenders' hands. Yushah broke through the wall and smashed the building, scattering its gems over the battlefield.

In Shadesmar, Kaladin, Shallan and Adolin had come to the city's Oathgate, but its spren would not let Shallan through. A Fused ran Adolin through with a lance, and the three were left stranded with no Stormlight.

Carrying The Way of Kings, Dalinar went out alone to meet the enemy. Lift, refusing to sail off with the Azish to wait out the storm, slipped away from her guard and came back, and Dalinar sent her after the Fused who had taken the King's Drop.
Szeth, watching from above with Nale, chose Dalinar as the one to follow and joined the fight, drawing Nightblood to help Lift.

With Odium's forces winning, Odium met Dalinar on the battlefield while Venli looked on. Dalinar challenged him to a contest of champions to save the city. Odium agreed, then told him he had been shaping Dalinar for years to be Odium's own champion.

Odium turned the full Thrill on Dalinar, flooding him with the pain of his past deeds and offering relief if he gave in. Dalinar refused and took responsibility for them. He swore his next Ideal with the words "I am Unity" and opened Honor's Perpendicularity.

The three Realms were joined in a flood of gloryspren and Stormlight that filled every gem in the city. Adolin, Shallan and Kaladin, trapped in Shadesmar, came back through the opening to join the fight, and Odium withdrew, leaving his army to fight on.

Shallan used Lightweaving to raise an army of illusions to draw off Amaram's soldiers, even giving them some substance. Jasnah drew on the vast Stormlight to destroy enemy troops with Surgebinding, and Renarin hurried to join the fight.
Amaram, given the gem that held the Unmade Yelig-nar, attacked Dalinar but was driven back by Kaladin. He then swallowed the gem to bond Yelig-nar, and carapace grew beneath his Shardplate.

Szeth and Lift won back the King's Drop, but flying Fused chased them. With Shallan's help they made a false gem and let the Fused take it back, and Lift carried the real one into the mist to Dalinar.

Near the Oathgate, Adolin, with his Shardblade Mayalaran, and the Thaylen guard Hrdalm fought the other thunderclast, Kai-garnis. Adolin wounded it badly but was hurt too much to go on. Renarin arrived to heal him, and he and Hrdalm, now holding Mayalaran, brought the creature down. Renarin went on to the Oathgate, where a dozen flying Fused stood guard.

In Urithiru, a surprise attack meant to stop the Alethi sending help was underway until Teft swore his Third Ideal and gained a Shardblade. He opened the Oathgate to Thaylen City and brought through reinforcements, whose arrival scattered the Fused.
On one of the singers' ships, Venli bonded the spren Timbre and became a Surgebinder.

In Nergaoul's mist, Lift gave Dalinar the King's Drop, a gem able to hold an Unmade. Embracing the Thrill, Dalinar drew Nergaoul in and trapped it in the gem. Amaram's soldiers came back to themselves; some fled and others collapsed.

Kaladin, out of Stormlight, was nearly killed by Amaram until Rock shot Amaram twice with a Shardbow and killed him. With their last great fighter gone, Odium's army retreated, and the Kholin troops cleared the remaining invaders from the city.
Afterwards Dalinar asked Navani to study the gem that now held Nergaoul. Taravangian admitted to Dalinar that he would have tried to take over the coalition had the Alethi fallen.
